title: Example: Mnemuron Hermes Adapter v0.1
goal: Example task: validate the Hermes adapter with your own isolated service and agent identity.
decisions: Hermes uses the independent identity hermes-example on device hermes-host.
Hermes events use workstream-hermes and never overwrite canonical task state.
Telegram /mnemuron continue only creates a Resume Preview; exact confirmation is required in a later message.
Confirmed Resume Packets are matched to hashed platform/session scope and injected once into the next ordinary Hermes turn.
Session-end details remain in raw_hook_payload while the content field is omitted, preventing a redundant low-quality Checkpoint after the assistant event.
Expired Preview conflicts return an explicit user-facing explanation instead of falling through to Hermes Unknown command; new Previews display Task status and a 30-minute expiry.
blockers: Example seed only; deployment-specific acceptance evidence has not been recorded.
next_steps: Configure isolated service and client identities for this example.
Run the documented acceptance checks and record actual results before marking the task complete.
